title: A Sinkhole Opened Right at a Funeral Home
script: A sinkhole opened where? Tuesday night, severe storms tore through Madison County, North Carolina — a funnel cloud spotted right near Marshall's Foster Creek community, tornado warnings up across the whole western half of the state. Then the ground gave out. A sinkhole swallowed the pavement directly in front of Madison Funeral Home. Not a field. Not a backyard. A funeral home. County manager Rod Honeycutt confirmed nobody was hurt and the building itself is fine — the real damage was downed trees, flooded roads, and knocked-out power across Marshall. Still, out of every spot in Madison County, the earth picked the one already handling the dead. So of all places in Marshall, why the funeral home?
